scope: Fixed 32x32 eye grids in four already-seen directions; no new holdout, lighting, RGB or formal-v3 acceptance test.
limitations: Historical holdout labels are retained only as names; all four views are seen validation.
Diagnostic IoU is role winner TP/(TP+FP+FN) on each original source-component bbox grid; not formal RGB/lighting score or statistical confidence.
White winner improvements can coexist with false positives; lid9 near/far-view overcoverage and remaining misses must be retained.
This audit recomputes aggregation from raw recorded BVH intersections, not new independent geometry raycasts.
